purpose: Clinical research to improve public health planning.
question: Compare active diuretic use in adults with heart failure.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
Diuretic = ATC code starting with C03CA.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per hospital: adults with heart failure, % with an active diuretic, one decimal.
